versions.title: エンディングのスキップ／CUBE SE（キューブが反応する瞬間の音）／解除のコマンドを戻した（音つき）／ポーズまわりの修正
changes: スタートメニューから始めたときだけ、エンディング中に 1P START を押すとエンディングを飛ばして次の周に進む。START を押したままエンディングに入ったときは、いったん離して押し直したときだけ飛ばす
キューブラッシュのポーズに CUBE SE を追加：キューブが反応する（自機を狙って加速する）瞬間に効果音を鳴らす。OFF か、音を4つ（SE 0E＝装備選択のカーソルの音・SE 29・SE 01・SE 1E）から選ぶ
メニューに入るための解除のコマンドを戻した：ゲーム中でないときに レバー上＋A → 両方離す → レバー下＋A → 両方離す（各段階3秒以内）。解除できると音が鳴る。遊ばずに約120秒たつと自動でロック（ロックのコマンドは無くした）
テストモードから CHARACTER ROM CHECK・COLOR TEST・COIN COUNTER TEST を外した（改造のための容量を作るため）。SCREEN CHECK・IO TEST・SOUND TEST・DIP SW SELECT は今までどおり
キューブラッシュのポーズで CUBE FLASH の行を CUBE COLOR の下・CUBE LINE の上に移した。キューブの区間を終えて頭から始め直したとき、CUBE FLASH と HIT DISP が OFF に戻っていたのを直した
スタートメニューで MODE を CUBE NO DEATH からほかのモードに切り替えると、最後の H の字が残っていたのを直した
NO DEATH の10面で、下へ降りる区間の後しばらく自機が画面の真ん中より上に行けなかったのを直した
verified: エンディング中に START を押すと飛ばして2周目1面が普通に始まること。START を押したままエンディングに入ると飛ばず、離して押し直すと飛ぶこと（MAME）
CUBE SE で、キューブが反応した回数と音が鳴った回数が同じ（46回中46回）で、遅れは2フレームであること（MAME）
解除のコマンドで音が鳴り、その後レバー上＋START でメニューに入ること。解除しないとメニューに入らず純正どおり始まること。デモ・タイトルのどの画面でも解除できること。解除から120秒で自動でロックされること（MAME）
テストモードが SCREEN CHECK → IO TEST → SOUND TEST → DIP SW SELECT の順に切り替わること（MAME）
START だけで始めた通常プレイが、前の版と同じように進むこと（3万フレーム・1面〜3面の始めまで、MAME）
メニューの各モードとディップスイッチ SW1:8 の OFF / ON で、NO DEATH の時間・キューブラッシュの残機・装備コマンドの回数が前の版と同じであること（MAME）
known: CUBE SE の音の種類は仮のもので、あとで変えるかもしれない
テストモードの CHARACTER ROM CHECK・COLOR TEST・COIN COUNTER TEST は使えない
ディップスイッチ SW1:8 を ON にすると、コイン2（2つ目のコイン投入口）の料金設定が「2枚以上で1クレジット」側だけになり、1枚1クレジットなどが選べなくなります（初期値の 1枚1クレは SW1:8 が OFF のときの設定です）。コイン2を使っていない場合は影響ありません
面クリア直後の即死の修正は、実機での確認がまだ
HIT DISP は地形の当たり（見えている地形の絵そのもの）は描かない。ON にすると処理が少し増える
CUBE FLASH が ON の間、CUBE COLOR の灰色（反応しないキューブ）は出ず、元の色になる。点滅の白の間に1フレームだけ元の色に戻ることがある
パワーアップで5速にしてから、それより遅い SPEED の装備コマンドを使うと、ゲージの SPEED UP の字が消えたままになる
オプションハンターは1周目の序盤など、ゲームの条件によってはもともと出ない（タイマーが進まない）
装備コマンドは装備を足すだけなので、レーザー・ダブルを持っている状態からミサイル＋START を押してもノーマルショットには戻らない
無敵中は壁の中に入り込める

en.title: Ending skip / CUBE SE (a sound when a cube reacts) / unlock command restored (with a sound) / pause menu fixes
changes: Only when you start from the start menu: pressing 1P START during the ending skips it and goes on to the next loop. If START is held when the ending begins, it skips only after you release START and press it again

Added CUBE SE to the Cube Rush pause menu: plays a sound effect at the moment a cube reacts (speeds up toward your ship). Choose OFF or one of four sounds (SE 0E = the cursor sound of the weapon select screen, SE 29, SE 01, SE 1E)

Restored the unlock command needed to enter the menu: when not in a game, Up + A → release both → Down + A → release both (each step within 3 seconds). A sound plays when it is unlocked. It locks automatically after about 120 seconds without play (the lock command was removed)
Removed CHARACTER ROM CHECK, COLOR TEST and COIN COUNTER TEST from the test mode (to make room for the mod). SCREEN CHECK, IO TEST, SOUND TEST and DIP SW SELECT work as before
In the Cube Rush pause menu, moved CUBE FLASH below CUBE COLOR and above CUBE LINE. Fixed CUBE FLASH and HIT DISP turning OFF when Cube Rush restarts from the top after the cube section
Fixed the last letter H staying on screen when switching MODE from CUBE NO DEATH to another mode in the start menu
Fixed: in NO DEATH stage 10, after the descending part, the ship could not go above the middle of the screen for a while
verified: Pressing START during the ending skips it and loop 2 stage 1 starts normally. Entering the ending with START held does not skip; releasing and pressing again skips (MAME)
With CUBE SE, the number of cube reactions and sounds match (46 of 46), with a delay of 2 frames (MAME)

The unlock command plays a sound, and Up + START then enters the menu. Without unlocking, the menu does not open and the game starts as in the original. Unlocking works on every demo/title screen. It locks automatically 120 seconds after unlocking (MAME)
The test mode cycles SCREEN CHECK → IO TEST → SOUND TEST → DIP SW SELECT (MAME)
Normal play started with START only proceeds the same as the previous version (30,000 frames, up to the start of stage 3, MAME)
For each menu mode and DIP switch SW1:8 OFF / ON, the NO DEATH time, Cube Rush lives and power-up command count are the same as the previous version (MAME)
known: The CUBE SE sounds are provisional and may change
CHARACTER ROM CHECK, COLOR TEST and COIN COUNTER TEST are not available in the test mode

Turning DIP switch SW1:8 ON also limits the Coin B (second coin slot) pricing to "2 or more coins per credit"; settings such as 1 Coin/1 Credit are no longer available (the default 1 Coin/1 Credit needs SW1:8 OFF). It makes no difference if you do not use the second coin slot
The fix for the sudden death right after a stage clear has not been checked on real hardware yet
HIT DISP does not show terrain hits (the visible terrain graphics are themselves the hit area). Turning it on adds a little processing
While CUBE FLASH is on, CUBE COLOR does not show gray for cubes that will not react; they keep their own color. During the white blink a cube can return to its color for one frame
If you reach speed 5 with power-ups and then use the power-up command with a slower SPEED, the SPEED UP label in the gauge stays blank
The Option Hunter does not appear at all under some game conditions, such as early in the first loop (its timer does not advance)
The power-up command only adds equipment, so pressing Missile + START while you have Laser or Double does not take you back to the normal shot
While invincible you can go inside walls

versions.title: NO DEATH モード・CUBE NO DEATH モード／当たり判定の表示（HIT DISP）／CUBE FLASH／面クリア後の即死を修正／キューブラッシュの左端の地形
changes: メニューの MODE に NO DEATH を追加：死なないモードを時間制で遊べる。1クレジット10分（ディップスイッチで5分）。自機を動かせる間だけ時間が減る。残り30秒から画面に TIME が出て、その表示中に START を押すとクレジットを1つ使って +10分（フリープレイはクレジットなし）。0 になるとその場でゲームオーバー。ハイスコアには入らない
NO DEATH のポーズで、装備（SPEED・MISSILE・DOUBLE/LASER・OPTION・SHIELD）を変えられる。MISS で自分から1機やられることもできる（残機は減らない）。最初の START 表示の間に操作の案内を出す
NO DEATH・CUBE NO DEATH のポーズに TIME を追加：残り時間を 分:秒 で読める（ポーズ中は時間が止まります）
メニューの MODE に CUBE NO DEATH を追加：キューブラッシュを死なない時間制で遊べる（時間と延長は NO DEATH と同じ）
NO DEATH で10面の下へ降りる区間（X 0800〜09C0）を降りずに上を進むと、画面が上のまま固定されて中ボスまで化けた画面になっていたのを直した。NO DEATH のときだけ、この区間では自機が上に行き過ぎないように押さえ、普通に遊んだときと同じように画面が下へ降りる
ディップスイッチ SW1:8 を ON にすると、NO DEATH の時間が10分→5分、キューブラッシュの残機の上乗せが +5→+2 になる（初期状態は OFF＝10分・+5）
ポーズに HIT DISP を追加（キューブラッシュ以外）：当たり判定を表示する。自機の当たりは赤い枠、敵・弾などの当たりはその場所の8ドットの升目に黄色の点
キューブラッシュのポーズに CUBE FLASH を追加：キューブが反応する少し前から、そのキューブを白く点滅させる。OFF / SHORT / NORMAL / LONG で点滅を始めるタイミングを選ぶ
キューブラッシュのポーズの CUBE LINE V と CUBE LINE H を CUBE LINE 1つにまとめた（縦と横をいつも両方出す）
キューブラッシュで、9面の左端の地形（迷路の最後のブロック）が出るようにした。キューブのくっつき方が実機と同じになる（MAME で最初の60個が実機と同じ位置に止まることを確認）。左端の砲台は出ない（グラディウス オリジン コレクションのトレーニングモードと同じ）。開始の位置・止まるまでの時間は今までどおり
面クリアの直後に、何もない所で自機がやられることがあるのを直した（純正のバグ。面が切り替わる瞬間に、地形の字が一瞬だけ当たりになっていた）。メニューから始めたときはいつも、START だけで始めたときはディップスイッチ SW1:5 が OFF（初期状態）のときに直る。SW1:5 を ON にすると純正どおり
9面で、キューブラッシュ以外のモードでリザードコアのあたりでやられると、キューブ地帯の手前から再開していた（キューブラッシュに切り替わったように見えた）のを、純正どおり面の最初から再開するように直した
verified: NO DEATH・CUBE NO DEATH が無敵・時間制で始まり、残り30秒の表示・延長・0 でのゲームオーバーが動くこと（MAME）
ディップスイッチ SW1:8 の OFF / ON で、NO DEATH の時間（10分 / 5分）とキューブラッシュの残機（+5 / +2）が切り替わること（MAME）
NO DEATH で10面の X 0800 から上を押し続けても、X 0C50 で普通の通路の画面になること（MAME）
HIT DISP で、自機の枠が自機に重なり、敵・弾の位置に印が出ること（1面・2面・5面、MAME）
CUBE FLASH で、反応の直前にキューブが点滅し、反応すると元の色に戻ること（MAME）
面が切り替わるときの書き込みの順が、SW1:5 OFF とメニューから始めたときは直した順、SW1:5 ON は純正どおりになること（MAME。もともと MAME ではタイミングの関係で自然には起きない）
キューブラッシュで、キューブの出る高さを同じ並びにしたとき、最初の60個が純正の9面と同じ位置に止まること（MAME。前の版は60個中23個がずれていた）
9面で NORMAL のまま X 05B0 でやられると、面の最初から再開すること（MAME）
NO DEATH のポーズの TIME が残り時間を出し、ポーズ中は止まり、延長すると増えること（MAME）
known: ディップスイッチ SW1:8 を ON にすると、コイン2（2つ目のコイン投入口）の料金設定が「2枚以上で1クレジット」側だけになり、1枚1クレジットなどが選べなくなります（初期値の 1枚1クレは SW1:8 が OFF のときの設定です）。コイン2を使っていない場合は影響ありません
面クリア直後の即死の修正は、実機での確認がまだ
10面の脱出の最後にやられることがある件は、面クリア直後の即死とは別の原因で、まだ調べていない
HIT DISP は地形の当たり（見えている地形の絵そのもの）は描かない。ON にすると処理が少し増える
CUBE FLASH が ON の間、CUBE COLOR の灰色（反応しないキューブ）は出ず、元の色になる。点滅の白の間に1フレームだけ元の色に戻ることがある
パワーアップで5速にしてから、それより遅い SPEED の装備コマンドを使うと、ゲージの SPEED UP の字が消えたままになる
オプションハンターは1周目の序盤など、ゲームの条件によってはもともと出ない（タイマーが進まない）
装備コマンドは装備を足すだけなので、レーザー・ダブルを持っている状態からミサイル＋START を押してもノーマルショットには戻らない
解除コマンドの一時停止中は、通常プレイでもレバー上か下を入れたまま START を押すとメニューに入る
無敵中は壁の中に入り込める

en.title: NO DEATH and CUBE NO DEATH modes / hitbox display (HIT DISP) / CUBE FLASH / fix for sudden death right after a stage clear / Cube Rush left-edge terrain
changes: Added NO DEATH to the menu MODE: play without dying on a timer. 10 minutes per credit (5 minutes with a DIP switch). Time only runs while you can move the ship. From 30 seconds left, TIME is shown; press START while it is shown to use one credit and add 10 minutes (no credit needed on free play). At 0 the game ends on the spot. Scores do not enter the high score table

In NO DEATH, the pause menu lets you change equipment (SPEED, MISSILE, DOUBLE/LASER, OPTION, SHIELD), and MISS lets you lose a ship on purpose (your stock does not go down). A short guide to the controls is shown during the first START display
Added TIME to the pause menu in NO DEATH and CUBE NO DEATH: shows the remaining time as minutes:seconds (the timer is stopped while paused)
Added CUBE NO DEATH to the menu MODE: Cube Rush without dying, on a timer (same time and extension as NO DEATH)

Fixed: in NO DEATH, going through the descending part of stage 10 (X 0800–09C0) without going down left the screen stuck high, showing garbled graphics until the mid-boss. In NO DEATH only, the ship is now kept from going too high in this part, so the screen goes down as in normal play
With DIP switch SW1:8 ON, the NO DEATH time becomes 5 minutes instead of 10, and the extra lives in Cube Rush become +2 instead of +5 (default OFF = 10 minutes, +5)
Added HIT DISP to the pause menu (outside Cube Rush): shows hitboxes. The ship's hitbox is a red box; enemies, bullets and so on get yellow dots in the 8-dot cells their hitbox covers
Added CUBE FLASH to the Cube Rush pause menu: a cube blinks white shortly before it reacts. Choose when the blinking starts with OFF / SHORT / NORMAL / LONG
Merged CUBE LINE V and CUBE LINE H in the Cube Rush pause menu into one CUBE LINE item (vertical and horizontal lines are always shown together)

In Cube Rush, the terrain at the left edge of stage 9 (the last blocks of the maze) now appears, so cubes stick the same way as on the arcade (in MAME the first 60 cubes stop at the same positions as the original). The turrets at the left edge do not appear (as in the training mode of Gradius Origins). The start position and the time until the screen stops are unchanged

Fixed the ship sometimes being destroyed in empty space right after a stage clear (a bug in the original: when the stage changes, a terrain character could become solid for a moment). The fix is always on when you start from the menu; when you start with START only, it is on while DIP switch SW1:5 is OFF (the default). With SW1:5 ON the game behaves like the original

Fixed: in stage 9, outside Cube Rush, losing a ship around the Lizard Core restarted you in front of the cube section (it looked as if the game switched to Cube Rush). You now restart from the beginning of the stage, as in the original
verified: NO DEATH and CUBE NO DEATH start invincible on a timer; the 30-second display, the extension and the game over at 0 work (MAME)
DIP switch SW1:8 OFF / ON switches the NO DEATH time (10 / 5 minutes) and the Cube Rush extra lives (+5 / +2) (MAME)
In NO DEATH, holding up from X 0800 in stage 10 still shows the normal corridor at X 0C50 (MAME)
With HIT DISP, the red box sits on the ship and dots appear where enemies and bullets are (stages 1, 2 and 5, MAME)
With CUBE FLASH, a cube blinks just before it reacts and returns to its color when it reacts (MAME)

When the stage changes, the write order is the fixed one with SW1:5 OFF or when started from the menu, and the original one with SW1:5 ON (MAME; in MAME the bug does not happen by itself because of timing)
In Cube Rush, with the same sequence of cube heights, the first 60 cubes stop at the same positions as in the original stage 9 (MAME; the previous version had 23 of 60 in different places)
In stage 9 in NORMAL, losing a ship at X 05B0 restarts from the beginning of the stage (MAME)
TIME in the NO DEATH pause menu shows the remaining time, stops while paused, and goes up after an extension (MAME)
known: Turning DIP switch SW1:8 ON also limits the Coin B (second coin slot) pricing to "2 or more coins per credit"; settings such as 1 Coin/1 Credit are no longer available (the default 1 Coin/1 Credit needs SW1:8 OFF). It makes no difference if you do not use the second coin slot
The fix for the sudden death right after a stage clear has not been checked on real hardware yet
Losing a ship at the very end of the stage 10 escape has a different cause from the stage-clear death and has not been looked into yet
HIT DISP does not show terrain hits (the visible terrain graphics are themselves the hit area). Turning it on adds a little processing
While CUBE FLASH is on, CUBE COLOR does not show gray for cubes that will not react; they keep their own color. During the white blink a cube can return to its color for one frame
If you reach speed 5 with power-ups and then use the power-up command with a slower SPEED, the SPEED UP label in the gauge stays blank
The Option Hunter does not appear at all under some game conditions, such as early in the first loop (its timer does not advance)
The power-up command only adds equipment, so pressing Missile + START while you have Laser or Double does not take you back to the normal shot
While the unlock command is suspended, pressing START while holding Up or Down enters the menu even in normal play
While invincible you can go inside walls

versions.title: ボスラッシュモードと追加の開始位置をいったん外した／START 表示の間の地形を隠す／メニューの整理

メニュー：SPEED・CAPSULE を FULL POWER SPEED・FULL POWER CAPSULE に、SHD COLOR を SHIELD COLOR に改名。初期値は FULL POWER SPEED 3・CAPSULE シールド。CUBE HEIGHT・SHIFT・TYPE はキューブラッシュのときだけ選べる。シールドの色の見本に自機とフォースフィールドを出す
キューブラッシュも開始スピードは 0（メニューの FULL POWER SPEED は装備コマンドを使ったときだけ）
verified: MODE が NORMAL と CUBE RUSH だけになり、BOSS RUSH が選べないこと
10面 ❶・10面 H・BOSS RUSH の行の A〜E・キューブラッシュが、正しい位置から始まること（MAME）
BOSS RUSH の行から始めて死んだとき、その地点から再開すること
外した機能を戻すビルドの切り替えで、前の開発版と同じ ROM になること
known: キューブラッシュでは、9面の左端の地形が出ないので、キューブのくっつき方が実機と変わることがある（直し方を検討中）
パワーアップで5速にしてから、それより遅い SPEED の装備コマンドを使うと、ゲージの SPEED UP の字が消えたままになる
オプションハンターは1周目の序盤など、ゲームの条件によってはもともと出ない（タイマーが進まない）

解除コマンドの一時停止中は、通常プレイでもレバー上か下を入れたまま START を押すとメニューに入る

en.title: Boss Rush mode and the added start points removed for now / terrain hidden during the START display / menu cleanup
changes: Removed BOSS RUSH from the menu MODE (planned to come back in a later version). MODE is now NORMAL or CUBE RUSH

Removed the adjusted start points from the stage and area table (stage 1 ❶, stage 3 ❶, stage 5 ❶❷, stages 6–8 ❶, stage 9 ❶❷, stage 10 ❷–❹; planned to come back later). What remains: the starts of the original areas (letters), stage 10 ❶ (after the boss rush), the BOSS RUSH row (partway through the boss rush section of stage 10) and EX STAGE
Fixed: starting from the BOSS RUSH row (stage 10 boss rush section) with MODE set to NORMAL started from the beginning of the stage. If you die there you now restart from that point
When starting mid-stage or restarting after death, the terrain and background are not shown during the START display (as in the original restart after death; half-drawn terrain used to be visible)

Menu: SPEED and CAPSULE renamed to FULL POWER SPEED and FULL POWER CAPSULE, SHD COLOR to SHIELD COLOR. Defaults are FULL POWER SPEED 3 and CAPSULE on shield. CUBE HEIGHT, SHIFT and TYPE can only be changed in Cube Rush. The shield color sample shows the ship with the force field
Cube Rush also starts at speed 0 (the menu FULL POWER SPEED only applies when you use the power-up command)
verified: MODE offers only NORMAL and CUBE RUSH; BOSS RUSH cannot be selected
Stage 10 ❶, stage 10 H, BOSS RUSH rows A–E and Cube Rush start at the correct positions (MAME)
After starting from the BOSS RUSH row and dying, you restart from that point
With the switch that restores the removed features, the ROM is identical to the previous development build
known: In Cube Rush the terrain at the left edge of stage 9 is missing, so cubes can stick differently from the arcade (fix under consideration)
If you reach speed 5 with power-ups and then use the power-up command with a slower SPEED, the SPEED UP label in the gauge stays blank
The Option Hunter does not appear at all under some game conditions, such as early in the first loop (its timer does not advance)
The power-up command only adds equipment, so pressing Missile + START while you have Laser or Double does not take you back to the normal shot
While the unlock command is suspended, pressing START while holding Up or Down enters the menu even in normal play

CUBE HUNTER ON (only the first one appears) and OFF (none appear)
Pressing START without the joystick starts the game exactly like the original
known: Stage 3 ❶ (before the boss): after the screen stops, the upside-down volcano enemies continue for a while before the boss appears (progress while stopped depends on time, so it cannot be skipped by moving the start point later)
Stage 5 ❷ is inside the section where the screen stops for the mid-boss, so the mid-boss appears / the boss music does not play (under investigation)

When starting from the menu at an area in the middle of a stage, the background colors are garbled only while the START screen is shown (does not happen when restarting after dying; under investigation)
The exact position of stage 10 ❹ (escape) has not been checked in detail yet
The Option Hunter does not appear at all under some game conditions, such as early in the first loop (its timer does not advance)
The power-up command only adds equipment, so pressing Missile + START while you have Laser or Double does not take you back to the normal shot
While the unlock command is suspended, pressing START while holding Up or Down enters the menu even in normal play

versions.title: 飛んでくるキューブを反応する位置で色分け（ポーズの CUBE COLOR）／ポーズでキューブの並びがずれないように／装備コマンドの組み合わせを変更
changes: ポーズメニューに CUBE COLOR（初期値 OFF）を追加。ON にすると、キューブラッシュで飛んでくるキューブを、反応する位置ごとに色分け（右から1・2番目は元の色、3番目から青→水色→青緑→緑→黄緑→黄→橙→赤、反応しないものは灰色）。色は出た瞬間から付き、くっつくまで変わらない

verified: CUBE COLOR を ON にしてキューブラッシュを最後まで流し、各色・灰色が付くこと、ラッシュ後のボスが元の色で出ること
約220フレームポーズしても LAG が出ず、並びが計算どおりのままであること
ミサイル＋START で装備が付くこと
起動時のRAM/ROMチェック
known: 装備コマンドは装備を足すだけなので、レーザー・ダブルを持っている状態からミサイル＋START を押してもノーマルショットには戻らない

en.title: Color incoming cubes by reacting position (CUBE COLOR in the pause menu) / pausing no longer shifts the cube sequence / changed the power-up command combinations
changes: Added CUBE COLOR (default OFF) to the pause menu. When ON, incoming cubes in Cube Rush are colored by the position where they react (1st and 2nd from the right keep their original color; from the 3rd: blue → light blue → teal → green → yellow-green → yellow → orange → red; cubes that do not react are gray). The color is applied from the moment the cube appears and does not change until it sticks
The coloring also borrows a color slot used only in boss fights, so the original colors are restored when the rush ends (or when it is set to OFF)
The frame timer now stops while paused. Previously the cube sequence shifted by the amount of time spent paused

Changed the power-up command combinations: START = full power-up with Laser, Shot + START = full power-up with Double, Missile + START = full power-up with the normal shot (Speed ×2, Missile, 4 Options, Shield), Shot + Missile + START = Speed ×2, Missile, 2 Options
verified: With CUBE COLOR ON, ran Cube Rush to the end; every color and gray was applied, and the boss after the rush appeared in its original colors
Pausing for about 220 frames causes no LAG, and the sequence stays as calculated
Missile + START gives the power-ups
RAM/ROM check at startup
known: The power-up command only adds equipment, so pressing Missile + START while you have Laser or Double does not take you back to the normal shot
While the unlock command is suspended, pressing START while holding Up or Down enters the menu even in normal play
While invincible you can go inside walls

versions.title: キューブラッシュの並びを選べるように／プレイ中に並び・ずれを表示／メニューの配置と背景／10面ボスラッシュの開始地点を調整
changes: キューブラッシュの並びを CUBE HEIGHT（1〜16）・SHIFT（A〜D）・TYPE（01〜45）で選べるように。純正の出方の法則（1個目が出る瞬間のタイマーで99個の並びが決まる）に沿った 16×4×45＝2880 通り。2個目以降は純正のまま進む
3項目それぞれ RANDOM あり。初期値は全部 RANDOM で、3つとも RANDOM のときは純正のまま（何もいじらない）
これまでの CUBE PATTERN（0〜99）は廃止
キューブラッシュ中にポーズの CUBE INFO を ON にすると、ハイスコアと 2P のスコアの場所に「CUBE:37 H:05 S:B T:12」（今何個目・並び）を表示。RANDOM で1個目が出る前は「?」。OFF に戻すとハイスコアと 2P の表示に戻る。初期値は OFF。見出しは暗め・数字は明るめ
処理落ちで並びが計算と変わったら、2段目に「LAG:12+0005」（最初に並びが変わったキューブの番号＋ずれの累計フレーム数。累計は出るたびに更新）を表示。並びが変わらない小さなずれでは出さない
RANK DISP をスタートメニューからポーズメニューへ移動（初期値は OFF）。表示は「RANK:10」の形で2段目の右端（T の数字の右端にそろえる）
ポーズメニューを5項目に（CONTINUE / GAME OVER / INVINCIBLE / RANK DISP / CUBE INFO）
キューブラッシュの残機を、ディップスイッチの残機 +4 に（3機設定なら7機）
キューブラッシュでキューブが1個くっつくたびに 1000点。ハイスコア・ランキング・残機の増加には影響しない
スタートメニューに SPEED（開始時のスピード 0〜5）と CAPSULE（開始時のカプセルゲージの位置 OFF / SPEEDUP〜!）を追加
メニューの配置を変更：見出し・CREDIT の表示と LIVES の項目をなくし（残機はディップスイッチどおり）、INVINCIBLE を最上段に、MODE・LOOP・面の表・CUBE の間を1行ずつ空け、最下段に PUSH START。STAGE 1〜10 の数字を右揃えに
SHD COLOR の右にフリーシールド（丸い玉1つ）の色見本を表示（選んだ色にその場で変わる）
メニューの背景に、3面ボス（ビッグコアMkIII）が反射レーザーを撃っている場面を暗くして表示（ボス・レーザー・自機のスプライトのみ。ゲーム開始時に色は元に戻る）
メニューの START 項目・BACK TO DEMO・SHOT2 で戻る機能を削除（メニューに入ったら START で必ず開始）
BOSS RUSH A〜E（10面ボスラッシュのボス2〜6）の開始地点を、ボスの約10秒手前に戻した
verified: H5・SB・T12 で、99個の高さが計算どおりの並びになり、メニューで待つ時間を変えても同じ並びになること
H だけ指定して残りを RANDOM にすると、最初の高さは指定どおりで、並びは毎回変わること
BOSS RUSH A〜E それぞれ、開始後に対応するボスが出現すること
H5・SB・T12 で CUBE INFO を ON にすると最上段に「H:5 S:B T:12」、OFF に戻すと HI・2P のスコアが描き直されること。武器選択画面では出ないこと
わざとタイマーをずらすと「LAG:」とずれた番号が出ること

キューブラッシュで1個くっつくごとに 1000点入り、20000点・90000点を超えても残機が増えず、ハイスコアも変わらないこと。ゲームオーバー後にランキングへ入らないこと（通常モードでは入ること）
SPEED 3・CAPSULE LASER で始めると、開始時にスピード3段階・ゲージが LASER の位置になっていること
起動時のRAM/ROMチェック すべてOK
known: キューブの並びは処理落ちがないときの法則。処理落ちで出る間隔がずれると、そこから先は計算と変わる（純正と同じ）

en.title: Choose the Cube Rush sequence / show the sequence and drift during play / menu layout and background / adjusted the start points of the stage 10 boss rush
changes: The Cube Rush sequence can now be chosen with CUBE HEIGHT (1–16), SHIFT (A–D) and TYPE (01–45): 16 × 4 × 45 = 2880 sequences that follow the original rule (the timer at the moment the first cube appears decides the sequence of 99 cubes). From the second cube on, it proceeds as in the original
Each of the 3 items has RANDOM. All default to RANDOM, and when all three are RANDOM the game behaves exactly like the original (nothing is changed)
Removed the former CUBE PATTERN (0–99)

Turning CUBE INFO ON in the pause menu during Cube Rush shows "CUBE:37 H:05 S:B T:12" (current cube number and sequence) in the high score and 2P score areas. With RANDOM, it shows "?" before the first cube appears. Turning it OFF restores the high score and 2P display. Default OFF. Labels are dim and numbers bright

If slowdown makes the sequence differ from the calculation, the second line shows "LAG:12+0005" (number of the first cube whose sequence changed + total frames of drift, updated each time a cube appears). Small drift that does not change the sequence is not shown
Moved RANK DISP from the start menu to the pause menu (default OFF). It is shown as "RANK:10" at the right end of the second line (aligned with the right end of the T number)
The pause menu now has 5 items (CONTINUE / GAME OVER / INVINCIBLE / RANK DISP / CUBE INFO)
Cube Rush lives are now the DIP switch setting + 4 (7 lives with the 3-life setting)
In Cube Rush, each cube that sticks gives 1000 points. This does not affect the high score, rankings or extra lives
Added SPEED (speed at start, 0–5) and CAPSULE (power-up gauge position at start, OFF / SPEEDUP to !) to the start menu

Changed the menu layout: removed the heading, the CREDIT display and the LIVES item (lives follow the DIP switches), moved INVINCIBLE to the top, added a blank line between MODE, LOOP, the stage table and CUBE, and put PUSH START at the bottom. STAGE 1–10 numbers are right-aligned
A color sample of the free shield (one round ball) is shown to the right of SHD COLOR (it changes immediately to the chosen color)
The menu background shows a darkened scene of the stage 3 boss (Big Core Mk III) firing reflecting lasers (boss, laser and ship sprites only; colors return to normal when the game starts)
Removed the menu's START item, BACK TO DEMO, and returning with SHOT2 (once in the menu, START always starts the game)
Moved the start points of BOSS RUSH A–E (bosses 2–6 of the stage 10 boss rush) back to about 10 seconds before each boss
verified: With H5, SB, T12 the 99 heights follow the calculated sequence, and the sequence is the same even if you wait a different time in the menu
Specifying only H and leaving the rest RANDOM gives the specified first height, with a different sequence each time
For each of BOSS RUSH A–E, the corresponding boss appears after starting
With H5, SB, T12 and CUBE INFO ON, the top line shows "H:5 S:B T:12"; turning it OFF redraws the HI and 2P scores. It does not appear on the weapon select screen
Deliberately shifting the timer shows "LAG:" and the shifted number
The SHD COLOR sample changes to the chosen color, and the shield (BLUE) after the game starts has the same color as the original
The menu background is shown, and when the game starts the colors and screen return to the same as v0.4.4
Normal play without entering the menu has the same screen as v0.4.4 (2 bytes in an unused area of shared RAM are used for random numbers)
Turning RANK DISP ON/OFF in the pause menu shows/erases it. Cube Rush has 7 lives with the 3-life setting. In normal play the HI and 2P scores are shown

In Cube Rush each stuck cube adds 1000 points; going past 20000 and 90000 points does not add lives, and the high score does not change. After game over you are not entered in the rankings (in normal mode you are)
Starting with SPEED 3 and CAPSULE LASER gives speed level 3 and the gauge at the LASER position at the start
RAM/ROM check at startup: all OK
known: The cube sequence follows the rule when there is no slowdown. If slowdown shifts the appearance interval, the sequence differs from the calculation from that point on (same as the original)
While the unlock command is suspended, pressing START while holding Up or Down enters the menu even in normal play
While invincible you can go inside walls

en.title: Power-up command, menu cleanup, fixed cube pattern
changes: After the menu, the game goes to the original weapon select screen (WEAPON SELECT) without showing the Technical / Beginner select (Beginner cannot be chosen)
Cleaned up the menu items: removed BEGINNER, WEAPON, EDIT, SHIELD and the starting equipment items (now 12 items)

MODE has three options: NORMAL / CUBE RUSH / BOSS RUSH. The hidden stages moved to the STAGE choices (GRADIUS / SALAMANDER). After a hidden stage you return to before the final boss of stage 10 (same as the original)

Power-up command during play: START = Speed ×2, Missile, Laser, 4 Options, Barrier / SHOT + START = Double instead of Laser / MISSILE + START = Speed ×2, Missile, 2 Options. The power-up gauge is set to SPEED UP
Power-up command uses: once per game in NORMAL (including hidden stages), unlimited in CUBE RUSH and BOSS RUSH
Pause is now a long press of START (about 1 second)
New item CUBE PATTERN: 0 = as in the original, 1–99 = fixes the sequence of cube appearance heights (the same sequence on each start and restart)
Changed the idle time before auto-lock from 60 seconds to 300 seconds
Renamed the menu's CANCEL to "BACK TO DEMO" (SHOT2 also returns to the demo; the credit is not used up)
Fix: when the attract mode looped, the frame counter returned to 0 and auto-lock could kick in early
verified: Menu → weapon select screen → start at the chosen stage (loop 1, loop 2, chosen area, hidden stages, Cube / Boss Rush)
Results of the 3 power-up commands, a second use not working in NORMAL, repeated use in Boss Rush, starting from a hidden stage
Long press of START pauses (no power-ups given)
CUBE PATTERN: the same number gives the same sequence even with different input timing. 0 differs every time
RAM/ROM check at startup: all OK
Auto-lock after 300 seconds (18000 frames) idle
BACK TO DEMO / SHOT2 return to the demo and the credit remains
known: The power-up command "adds what is missing". If you have more Options or Barrier than the target, they are not reduced (speed is set back to level 2)
The cube appearance heights can be fixed, but their movement after appearing and the return fire may vary depending on slowdown
The underground respawn point on stage 10, separate checkpoints for the stage 10 bosses, and the edit screen extension are not implemented
The main ROM has almost no free space left, so future features will require cleanup
